title: Gate D: the preregistered grounding experiment's conditions are what the protocol says
note: D-2026-182. Each breaks a condition's definition or the registration: a gate that passes everything, a state answer from a conflict or a withdrawn record, a gate checking another condition's answer (Tranche G's confound reopened), a run under unregistered parameters. tests/test_grounding_experiment.py holds each.

mutations.name: GD1_the_semantic_gate_passes_everything
mutations.rationale: D: an unsupported answer is counted as gated and supported

mutations.name: GD2_the_state_answers_a_conflict
mutations.rationale: D: the state picks one of two disagreeing runs

mutations.name: GD3_the_state_ignores_a_withdrawal
mutations.rationale: D: the state answers from a withdrawn record

mutations.name: GD4_a_gate_substitutes_the_governed_answer
mutations.rationale: D: the gates check another condition's answer, the confound reopened

mutations.name: GD5_unregistered_parameters_run
mutations.rationale: D: a confirmatory run starts under parameters the protocol never registered
